headline: Qualcomm is betting big on data centers as smartphone sales sink
summary: Qualcomm faces a 20% drop in smartphone sales. The company is now focusing on the AI data center market. New partnerships with Amazon and Meta underpin this strategic shift.

headline: 17 better ways Elon Musk could have wasted $446 million
summary: The article critiques excessive social media use and its negative effects. It highlights Elon Musk's substantial investment in the former Twitter as wasteful. It proposes more beneficial ways the money could have been spent.

headline: How I learned to love an obnoxious phone grip
summary: The author initially found a friend's 'butter'-themed phone grip unappealing. Despite initial reservations, the convenience and style of the grip won them over. This personal piece explores adapting to quirky tech accessories.

headline: Bose’s QuietComfort Headphones are more than half off
summary: The first-gen Bose QuietComfort Headphones are currently over 50% off. Priced at $169.99, this matches their lowest price ever. The deal is available at Amazon, Best Buy, and Bose directly.

headline: Leonardo DiCaprio and Joaquin Phoenix Were Offered the Role of the Joker in The Dark Knight, But Turned it Down
summary: Leonardo DiCaprio and Joaquin Phoenix were both offered the role of The Joker. They ultimately declined the part in Christopher Nolan's 'The Dark Knight'. This information comes from the film's casting director.

headline: GTA 6 Rakes in Over $750 Million in Preorders 2 Weeks Ahead of Release Date
summary: GTA 6 has generated over $750 million in preorders. This impressive sum was achieved two weeks before its official release. Preorders cover both PlayStation 5 and Xbox platforms.

headline: Today’s Best Deals: Marvel’s Wolverine, Apple Watch Ultra 3, and MTG Reality Fracture Booster Box
summary: PlayStation's Black Friday Sale is currently live. It's the last opportunity to get $10 off a Zelda: Ocarina of Time preorder. Deals also feature Marvel's Wolverine, Apple Watch Ultra 3, and Magic: The Gathering booster boxes.

headline: Adam Driver Says He's Done Playing Kylo Ren, but Would Return if Someone Revived His Canceled Solo Film
summary: Adam Driver has declared he is finished portraying Kylo Ren in Star Wars. However, he expressed willingness to return if his canceled solo film project was resurrected. This suggests a conditional possibility for his return to the franchise.

headline: Bowen: Trump's loss limits powers at home, but it will likely be different abroad
summary: President Trump's domestic influence is diminished after midterm election losses. Despite this, he is expected to assert his power on the international stage. The BBC's international editor suggests he will focus on global affairs.

headline: How America voted in maps and charts
summary: Detailed maps and charts illustrate the results of the US midterm elections. These visuals provide insight into America's voting patterns. The graphics explain how different regions cast their ballots.

headline: What Democrats can and can't do with their new power after taking Congress
summary: Democrats gained new legislative power after taking control of Congress. They now have the ability to vote legislation through. However, President Trump still holds veto power over their bills.

headline: Everything you need to know from the US midterm elections
summary: Democrats achieved significant victories in the recent US midterm elections. They also secured several historic firsts in the process. President Trump extended congratulations to them on their success.
